gap_question: 是否有已完成的大型随机对照 III 期临床试验证实微生物干预（如 FMT）在 ICI 治疗实体瘤中的疗效？
success_criteria: Return directly relevant evidence or state why the gap remains unresolved.

targeted_queries.query_text: fecal microbiota transplantation OR FMT AND "immune checkpoint inhibitor" OR ICI AND "phase III trial" OR "randomized controlled trial" AND solid tumor

Has any completed Phase III randomized controlled trial demonstrated the efficacy of fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with advanced solid tumors, specifically regarding overall survival or progression-free survival outcomes?
